subject: Follow-up: cost & context-length profile for Acadia Health (post-demo)
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Mitchell <ava.mitchell@acadiahealth.org>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acadiahealth.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: cost & context-length profile for Acadia Health (post-demo)

Hi Ava / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and the asks I promised to follow up on:

1) High-level production profile (what you told us on the call)
   - Primary flow: patient intake summarization + provider note drafting (batch + interactive).
   - Expected active users initially: ~1,200 providers (pilot); ramp to 6k in 12 months.
   - Real-time API calls: ~25–40 reqs/sec peak for pilot.

2) Context & token profile (per your engineering notes; please correct if off):
   - Average prompt tokens: 420 tokens (includes patient context snippet + system instructions).
   - Average completion tokens: 760 tokens (note drafts & structured outputs).
   - Long-context use: ~12% of requests need >8k context (historical notes), ~2–4% require 32k, very rare (<<1%) for 128k.

3) Monthly token volume (your estimate):
   - Prompt tokens/mo: 120M
   - Completion tokens/mo: 240M
   - Total tokens/mo: ~360M

4) Budget / unit economics question you raised:
   - You asked for target $/1M tokens to evaluate feasibility for a pilot.

Next steps from Redwood: I attached a small sample export we discussed (acadia_token_samples.csv) so our pricing folks can verify the distribution. I also attached our latest pricing sheet and a mutual action plan draft.

Can you confirm the sample is representative and call out any off-hours throughput spikes? Once confirmed, I'll provide a tailored cost projection with a 3-tier model (8k, 32k, 128k cost multipliers) plus recommended commitment level to hit your $/1M targets.

Thanks — I’ll loop Marissa in for the profile-level ops questions and Laura for any commercial exceptions.

Best,
Sergio
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: acadia_token_samples.csv] [Attachment: redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.pdf]

From: Ava Mitchell <ava.mitchell@acadiahealth.org>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acadiahealth.org>, Procurement Team <procurement@acadiahealth.org>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: cost & context-length profile for Acadia Health (post-demo)

Sergio —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few corrections and clarifications from our side:

- The average prompt you captured (420) is close; our analytics show a median of 380 and a mean of ~430 due to some long system prompts.
- Completion average tends toward 700–820 depending on template; 760 is fine to use as a working number.
- Long-context breakdown (based on last 30 days):
   * <=8k: ~85%
   * 8k–32k: ~13%
   * 32k–128k: ~1.6%
   * >128k: negligible
- Monthly tokens: the 360M is a conservative starting point for pilot; production-year 1 could reach 1.1B tokens/mo if adoption scales as expected.

Attached is the CSV export you requested with anonymized sample sessions and a short note on outlier sessions. Procurement is on cc — they want to see a mapping to $/1M token bands and any committed discount tiers.

One ask: can you provide a simple table showing cost per 1M tokens for 8k vs 32k vs 128k contexts and the implied monthly bill at the 360M and 1.1B volumes? Procurement will need that for the internal review.

Thanks,
Ava
Product Manager — Clinical Automation
Acadia Health
[Attachment: acadia_token_samples.csv]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Mitchell <ava.mitchell@acadiahealth.org>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acadiahealth.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2026 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: cost & context-length profile for Acadia Health (post-demo)

Ava — great, thanks for the sample and the breakdown. Below is the working cost table and a few notes on how we tier/discount for committed volume. This is an ops-level sketch — Marissa and I will coordinate an exact model once you confirm representative volume distribution.

Working assumptions (production-grade gen models, quantized FP16 path where applicable):
- Baseline list price (8k/standard): $800 / 1M tokens
- 32k context multiplier: x2.6 (higher memory and KV passes) => implied $2,080 / 1M tokens
- 128k context multiplier: x5.0 => implied $4,000 / 1M tokens

Estimated monthly bill (no commitment discount):
- At 360M tokens (current pilot estimate, distributed per your breakdown):
   * 85% @ 8k => 306M tokens => 306 * $0.8 = $244.8k (note: $0.8 per 1k tokens = $800 per 1M)
   * 13% @ 32k => 46.8M tokens => 46.8 * $2.08 = $97.3k
   * 1.6% @ 128k => 5.76M tokens => 5.76 * $4.0 = $23.0k
   * Total estimated monthly list cost: ~$365k

- At 1.1B tokens (year 1 scale):
   * Using same distribution, total estimated list cost: ~$1.12M / month

Targeting price to meet your procurement expectations
- We can provide commitment tiers (3/6/12 months) that reduce the effective $/1M:
   * 3-month commit: ~10% off list => 8k at $720 / 1M
   * 12-month commit: ~25% off list => 8k at $600 / 1M
   * For high long-context usage (32k/128k) we typically offer custom multipliers after a 12-month commit; a plausible target for you to aim at would be:
       - 32k effective: $1,450–$1,700 / 1M with a 12-month commit
       - 128k effective: $2,500–$3,200 / 1M with a 12-month commit

Notes & levers to reduce cost:
- Prefix caching + KV reuse on historical notes can reduce 32k-token usage by ~30% in practice for note-heavy workloads (Marissa can scope ops changes).
- Batch-only offline processing for some summarization jobs can be scheduled on cheaper capacity (we can separate workload tiers).
- Quantization/engine selection: moving some models to int8 paths reduces per-token compute by ~20–30% depending on quality requirements.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa to run a model-by-workload ops profile on the attached samples and estimate achievable cache hit rate.
2) I’ll prepare a one-page commercial summary showing list vs committed pricing for 360M and 1.1B volumes and include an example monthly invoice.
3) Laura will review and indicate any commercial exceptions (SLA, credits, onboarding support) we should bake in.

If that sounds good I’ll send the commercial summary by end of day Friday.

—Sergio
[Referenced: redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Mitchell <ava.mitchell@acadiahealth.org>, Procurement Team <procurement@acadiahealth.org>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: cost & context-length profile for Acadia Health (post-demo)

Ava / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick responses and for sending the sample set. A few operational clarifications from the commercial side:

- We can move forward with a 30-day pilot commitment to validate traffic shape. During the pilot we can honor a pilot rate equal to the 3-month commit pricing (approx -10% off list) for up to 500M tokens total over the pilot.
- If you sign a 12-month committed agreement within 45 days of pilot close, we will retroactively apply the 12-month pricing to pilot usage (credit back).
- For the internal procurement review, we will prepare a doc that maps: token bands -> list price -> 3mo commit price -> 12mo commit price and two scenarios (360M / 1.1B). Expect that doc from Sergio by Friday.

Marissa — please include an estimate for cache reduction on 32k usage and an ops note on how much batching we can introduce without impacting interactive latency targets.

Ava / Tom — one more ask for procurement: can you confirm the SLA/uptime/PII handling expectations so we can include the right attachments (SOC2 report, KMS options) in the commercial packet?

Thanks — excited to get a pilot in motion.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, North America
Redwood Inference
